description: Defines constants, data structures, and macros for managing Memory Protection Units (MPU) in ARC V2 architecture within Zephyr OS. Includes region attributes, size definitions, and configuration structures.

classes.name: arc_mpu_region
classes.description: Represents an MPU region with name, base address, size, and attributes.

classes.name: arc_mpu_config
classes.description: Holds the configuration for multiple MPU regions, including the number of regions and a pointer to the regions array.

methods.name: MPU_REGION_ENTRY
methods.description: Macro to initialize an arc_mpu_region structure with specified name, base, size, and attributes.
